answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. In effect, the network makes cheating the most expensive strategy available, which is the closest thing to a Sybil-resistant design that economics allows.. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. Consider a onyx as the anchor of the cost.
